function.name: subagent_interrupt
function.description: Interrupt a subagent's active task, then send it the given message as a new task. An idle subagent receives the message immediately.

agent.description: The id of the subagent to interrupt (e.g. "agent-7"), as returned by subagent_spawn or subagent_list.

message.description: The new task input to send after the current task is interrupted.
